top10.name: SHENZHEN SOLITAIRE
top10.short_description: NO ENGINEERING, ALL PROCRASTINATION! SHENZHEN SOLITAIRE is a brand-new solitaire variant originally developed for SHENZHEN I/O, and is now available as a standalone game! It's simple but challenging, and oddly addictive.

top10.name: Supipara - Chapter 1 Spring Has Come!
top10.short_description: Spring has come, and our protagonist, Yukinari, returns home after 7 years. Between his second cousin Sakura, who meets him outside in a full maid outfit, Hotaru, a half-Japanese beauty with a sharp tongue, and the lazy scheming witch Alice - life just got way more interesting!

top10.name: Marvin's Mittens
top10.short_description: Marvin's Mittens presents a soothing world to explore, free from enemies and danger. Go on an adventure!

top10.name: Quell
top10.short_description: An enchanting game of logic and relaxation.

top10.name: Paint it Back
top10.short_description: Use logic as your paintbrush to restore lost works of pixel art. Try the demo!

top10.name: Bullet Heaven 2
top10.short_description: Bullet Heaven 2 is a bullet-hell shoot-em-up inspired by games like Touhou and Jamestown. It's all about shooting every cute thing that moves, while dodging hundreds of shiny bullets per second!

top10.name: Home Sheep Home: Farmageddon Party Edition
top10.developer: Aardman Animations, Mobile Pie, Black Smoke Studios
top10.short_description: Join Shaun the Sheep and his friends Timmy and Shirley on this epic adventure journeying through caverns, the busy streets of London and through outer space all in search of the green grass of home. Now with new multiplayer modes, controller support, widescreen graphics and much, much more!

top10.name: Voidspire Tactics
top10.short_description: An indie turn-based Tactics RPG with a heavy emphasis on exploration, character progression, and highly tactical combat. Create your own deeply customizable party of Warriors, Sorcerers, and Shiftcloaks to take on the Spire!

collisions.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III

top10.name: Crystal Story II
top10.short_description: Crystal Story II is a turn-based RPG that follows the story of a young Dragon on his quest to defeat an evil witch. He must seek allies to aid him on his journey and save the world from the oncoming invasion.

top10.name: Pinkman
top10.short_description: Pinkman is a fast-paced, action platformer about a lost man with pink skin and an incredible skill to fart.

next5.name: The Lands of Dream
next5.short_description: A cycle of adventure games set in the Lands of Dream, including The Sea Will Claim Everything.

next5.name: Gravity Ghost
next5.short_description: Gravity Ghost is a physics game with a twist. Run, jump, and soar around planets, using gravity to glide through the air. Explore a shattered galaxy and rescue its survivors, armed with powerups and mysterious terraforming powers. Meet the 7 magical guardians and best their challenges. There's no killing, no dying, and no way to fail.

next5.name: WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.02
next5.short_description: From the creator of Spice and Wolf, Isuna Hasekura, comes World End Economica. Haru woke up with his life but without his dream. 4 years after the incident, he finds a new cause, as a driven young lady offers him a chance to return to investing and to find justice.

next5.name: Nightmares from the Deep 2: The Siren`s Call
next5.short_description: Answer the siren`s call and defeat the cruel Mayor Murray and his pet sea monster, the Kraken

next5.name: Tin Star
next5.short_description: Ride out into the Old West as a U.S. marshal in the biggest interactive novel ever made! Confront outlaws, find romance, defy the elements, and craft an enduring legend as you uncover a conspiracy whose deadly web stretches from San Francisco to New York City.
